accepted.sentence: A torque-limiting handle clicks or slips at a preset force, signaling that a fastener has reached its intended tightness.
An extension transfers rotation from a handle outside a narrow opening to a tip seated deeper inside.
A long-shaft version reaches a recessed fastener below a panel surface without the handle touching surrounding material.
An offset version turns fasteners where a wall or neighboring component blocks a straight approach.
A flexible extension transmits hand rotation around a bend to a fastener hidden behind an obstruction.
When fastening a broad panel at several points, alternating among fasteners helps draw the panel evenly against its support.
During disassembly, setting removed fasteners in their original order can simplify returning each to its former location.
A guide sleeve around the tip can steady a small fastener as its threads first enter a hole.
